target: new: auricle (part of the bearer, slot 1) + length (PATO_0000122), numbers as in docs/odp/05-range-with-extremes.md
reason: A measurement of the auricles of a sepal or blade, not a quality word; the auricle is a part of the bearer. PO has only leaf sheath auricle (PO_0020106), which does not fit sepals or dicot blades.
'Blade auricles absent', 'standard sans auricules' = not auriculate. PO has no general auricle class (only PO_0020106 leaf sheath auricle), so entity_absence cannot be used.
Bland fruit = with little or no flavour, insipid. 'Bland to slightly sweet' is the low end of a flavour range.
'Scales concealing the surface' relates the scales to the surface they hide, which is the second term. It is a relation, not a quality of the scale alone.
Cymulose = bearing cymules (small cymes) as its ultimate units; cymule is a synonym of PO_0030126 cyme inflorescence.

label: diaphragmed
definition: A structure quality inhering in a pith by virtue of its being interrupted at regular intervals by transverse plates of firmer, thicker-walled cells. NOTE: Distinct from chambered pith (hollow between the plates); the 'septate' NARROW synonym of PATO:0001786 split concerns a division of the outline, not internal plates.
reason: A real pith character used for keys (e.g. Nyssa, Liriodendron) with no PATO or FLOPO term. The twig example refers to the twig's pith.
'Drying blackish brown' is the colour of the dried specimen. This is the specimen-condition pattern ('black when dry'); the quality is the colour.

target: new: two values: bearer scaly (PATO_0001804, rule C235 lepidote) + its scales (trichome PO_0000282, part of the bearer) orange (FLOPO:0988002, botanical colour synonym 'ferrugineous')
reason: A compound of two values: the leaf is covered with scales, and the scales are rust-coloured. The colour inheres in the scales, not the leaf.
A degree adverb ('finely to coarsely rugulose') that grades the following value. It is not a quality.
The colour part only: the old class FLOPO:0980110 'flushed with pink' is obsolete with consider FLOPO:0988000 pink, per the colour backbone migration.
Glassy spines, bristles and fruits are translucent like glass. This is the same reading as the earlier rule for pellucid (C237).

target: new: two values of one bearer: banded (PATO_0001946, EXACT synonym striped) + stripes gray (FLOPO:0988010)
reason: A compound of a pattern and the colour of the stripes; both values hold, on the abaxial surface where stated.
Minutely puberulent with slightly stiff hairs. There is no hirtellous term, so the head value puberulous carries it, as caudate-acuminate was mapped to caudate.
The examples say 'not coherent' (drupelets, fruits): the negation of the FLOPO value coherent.

target: new: two values of one bearer (elliptic PATO_0000947 and irregularly shaped PATO_0005020)
reason: The floras contrast it with plain 'ellipsoid', so the irregularity is part of the statement. Both values hold together, as with 'obliquely ovate'.
Maroon is a botanical colour synonym of FLOPO:0988001 red. As with 'flushed with pink', only the colour part is mapped.
'Narrowly' only grades the club shape; the value is clavate.

Nectar is a secretion, not a PO part, and 'without nectar' does not mean that the nectary is absent (empty spurs can have one). It needs a substance class, not a FLOPO term. The spur was also wrongly matched to short shoot.
The negation of the FLOPO value appressed.
The negation of PATO leaf-like (the earlier rule mapped foliaceous to it).
An oblique disc or corolla mouth is set at a slant to the axis; 'not oblique' negates that orientation. This is not the inequilateral leaf-base sense (C236).
The opposite of 'obscure' (rule C174, inconspicuous): the surface or costa is clearly visible. 'Not obscured by spines' is really about sparse spines, so the rule is weak there.
Not hanging down. PATO pendent is the nearest term, but its comment separates it from pendulous (hanging because the support is weak), so the negation may claim more than the source.
The negation of the backbone colour red, to which PATO_0000322 red is repointed. The bearers (pustule, pulp) need their own bearer rules.
'Laminae not coiling or reflexing' = the corolla laminae do not become reflexed.
The negation of PATO ridged (the parent of FLOPO ribbed).

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum between pilose FLOPO:0991048 and villous FLOPO:0991051)
reason: A hyphenated pair of two existing hair values, read as intermediate between them, like ovate-lanceolate.
As 'flushed with pink': only the colour part is mapped, to the backbone pink.
'Remnant leaf-bases' and 'style remnants' describe what remains of a part, i.e. a state of the bearer. The quality (density, position) is stated separately.
A rare word whose meaning differs between authors. There is not even a homostylous term to build on, so a term would be doubtful; 'or distylous' can be kept under heterostylous FLOPO:0991137.
